plain_statement: Petersen graph on 0-9: i ~ (i+1) mod 5 and i ~ i+5 for i < 5, i ~ 5 + (i+2) mod 5 for i >= 5. There are test families T and S, at most 6 gates j with variable sets V_j (each vertex in at most two) and families L_j, R_j such that: every maximal independent set I is in T, not in S, and for each w outside I some member of S, in T, lies inside I plus w; every member of each L_j, R_j lies in a piece inside it (the tests of T holding a vertex of V_j, or an earlier gate's L ∩ R); every member of S lies in some gate's L ∩ R inside S.

counterexample.description: Its literal negation pair, L-meta-7084, is checked (run-058772); recorded by the hub in the same act.
